title: Designing and Evaluating Malinowski’s Lens: An AI-Native Educational Game for Ethnographic Learning

bias_targets.methodology: Qualitative evaluation via think-aloud protocols and semi-structured interviews with general users and expert anthropologists to identify historical and cultural misrepresentations of indigenous Trobriand Islanders generated by AI, including the effects of DALL-E 3's forced diversity filters and the reinforcement of an anthropologist-centered colonial gaze.
